svg.text: Concept 5 · the Node stages run on the builder's processor ($BUILDPLATFORM), the final stage only copies · without emulation
1 · The kitchen on the BUILDER's processor, only once
every RUN (running a program) is here; its results,
node_modules and the dist/ folder, are the same for every processor
2 · Serving plates per TARGET processor: only COPY
no RUN: no program of another processor has to run
the base images (node, caddy) come in the target processor's variant; the rest is copied
compressed sizes in the author's lab (local image registry):
tag 2.0.0 and sha-<7 characters> point to the same index;
the index also holds 2 provenance notes (attestation,
pushed to the image shop: job build, platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64, on a push to main
4 · docker compose pull picks its own variant
free-path Pi (the center on the Pi)
amd64 / arm64 · the one that matches its processor
main-path Pi = the gateway: the official Mosquitto image (both processors from its publisher)
bcrypt (passwords, Module 20) is the only package that isn't plain JavaScript: bcrypt@6.0.0 carries ready-made builds for
linux-x64 AND linux-arm64 (musl, for Alpine) and picks the right one when the server runs. The author's lab: on the arm64 Pi, npm ci
with --cpu=x64 (npm picks the packages as if on an x64 machine) gives the same files as a plain npm ci (6,201 files, 0 different)
a native ARM runner (ubuntu-24.04-arm): each processor is built
on its own machine, then the indexes are joined
QEMU emulation: the other processor's RUN is imitated, much slower
the simulated robot on a Pi 5 (arm64) builds amd64 + arm64
without emulation; the arm64 image ran in staging and on the
simulated VPS; the amd64 image checked, not run
